rationale: Origination export: authoritative at closing, not refreshed after boarding.
Original principal is fixed at closing by the origination system; most authoritative here.
Balances drift after boarding; origination is stale on anything that changes.
Payment status changes post-closing; origination does not track it.
Delinquency is a servicing fact; origination cannot know it.
Origination does not own the document record; the manifest does.
Servicer feed: system of record for anything that changes after boarding.
Servicers sometimes re-key original terms; origination is more authoritative there.
Current balance is the servicer's core responsibility; most authoritative.
Payment status is maintained by the servicer; most authoritative.
Delinquency is computed by the servicer; most authoritative.
Servicer sees documents indirectly; the manifest is authoritative.
Document manifest asserts only document facts; trusted within that scope.
The manifest is the system of record for document completeness.
A reviewer's decision outranks every machine source and is pinned in loan_canonical.
